evidence: CUT_213/214 Hz gyro LPF implies about 0.74 ms first-order phase delay at a 1 kHz tick; +2 sample alignment lowered open-floor in-place old RMSE from 0.205513948 to 0.184035414 before tuning.
interpretation: A meaningful part of the old in-place residual was timing/filter phase, not missing contact torque.
next_action: Make estimator/replay effective-time handling explicit and validate command-to-gyro delay with a targeted chirp or step-yaw experiment.

evidence: At +2, open-floor mostly-forward has 1042144 samples and -26.733% exact improvement; moving-yaw has 494414 samples and -15.551%; in-place has 300727 samples and -4.035%.
interpretation: The selected scalar is rewarded mainly for broad moving/mostly-forward error reduction, so in-place yaw gets a weaker fit.
next_action: Fit/report per-motion and per-physics-basis coefficients in scratch before deciding whether one production scalar is defensible.

evidence: The installed correction collapses contact state to one load-weighted patch-yaw scalar and a symmetric patch-force couple; in pure in-place rolling reconstruction the forward-offset term is small and force projection can clip added force.
interpretation: The correction is spec-compatible but lacks features likely needed for scrub/static in-place behavior.
next_action: Evaluate spec-compatible features: lateral velocity proxy/reference, bristle/static deflection memory, fan/load dependence, low-speed regularization, and force-envelope saturation shape.

evidence: The correction is applied before projection; existing tests show high-rate in-place slip already reaches sustained lateral force limits.
interpretation: When contacts are already near the envelope, added pre-projection force may be mostly projected away.
next_action: Add replay diagnostics for correction before/after projection by motion class and saturation/utilization bin.

evidence: Validation-only open-floor old RMSE is about -52% offset from fit; competition stress is about +149% offset. Exact +2 selected gain slightly worsens validation-only open-floor (+1.713%) while improving competition stress (-13.211%).
interpretation: These splits show real regime/schema differences, not one homogeneous plant-fit population.
next_action: Keep them out of coefficient fitting; use them as stress/physics diagnostics and collect cleaner held-out targeted data.
